name: Prijsvrij Vakanties
verdict: A Dutch travel company, 75% owned by Dertour of the German REWE Group and 25% by its founder. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Feyenoord's back-of-shirt partner, deal extended through 2026-27. Majority owner Dertour is part of REWE Group, a cooperative owned by its member retailers (rewe-group-record); no state owner, so 'none'.
